description: Source file containing utility functions for handling list views in the vtiger CRM application, including functions to generate headers, entries, navigation, and retrieve field values, with integrations for permissions, custom views, and module-specific logic.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates headers for a list view in a module, considering sorting, permissions, and custom views.

methods.name: getSearchListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates headers for a search popup list view, similar to getListViewHeader but for search interfaces.

methods.name: getNavigationValues
methods.description: Calculates pagination navigation data based on current display page, total rows, and limit.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Fetches and formats list view entries with proper links, permissions, and formatting for a given module and query result.

methods.name: getSearchListViewEntries
methods.description: Fetches and formats list view entries for a popup/search interface, similar to getListViewEntries.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the display value of a particular field in a list view, handling various UI types and permissions.
